§6Flare Stack§f

§aGot excess gas or fluids clogging your system? Burn it off and reclaim some energy.§f

The Flare Stack eliminates excess flammable or gaseous fluids and recovers a small amount of power. It is the safety valve for your oil extraction setup.

§6Operation§f:
Supply a fluid and toggle the §bflow control valve§f and/or §bignition switch§f.
§b• Gas venting§f: Flow control valve only. Consumes §e50mB/t§f, no power generated.
§b• Liquid combustion§f: Both switches on. Generates §e10%§f of the fluid's combustion energy at §e10mB/t§f.
§b• Gas combustion§f: Both switches on. Generates §e20%§f of combustion energy at §e10mB/t§f.
§b• Speed upgrades§f: Each tier adds §e10mB/t§f consumption.

Crafted in the §bAssembly Factory§f with steel, iron, copper plates, pipes, shells, and thermoelectric elements.

§ePS:§f The §bDrainage Pipe§f voids fluids faster and cheaper, but the flare stack can recover marginal power from energy-dense fuels like §bKerosene§f.
